module_summary: Blocking direct-mapped cache controller: a 5-state FSM latches the CPU request, probes a child tag/data bank for hit, and on miss or write issues a memory req/ack transaction that refills or updates the bank.

anchors.name: mode
anchors.why: Controller state: wait, peek (tag check), push (write), pull (refill), done.

anchors.name: cpu_req_valid
anchors.why: CPU request valid; starts the FSM and loads the request latches.

anchors.name: cpu_req_ready
anchors.why: Request ready, asserted only in the wait state.

anchors.name: cpu_resp_valid
anchors.why: Response valid pulse decoded from the done state.

anchors.name: cpu_rdata
anchors.why: Response data, driven by the out_r result register.

anchors.name: lat_a
anchors.why: Latched request address; supplies bank slot/tag and the memory address.

anchors.name: lat_w
anchors.why: Latched write flag; steers peek to push (write) path versus read path.

anchors.name: found
anchors.why: Cache hit from child bank; selects done vs refill and gates write update.

anchors.name: refill_ok
anchors.why: Refill strobe: writes memory data into bank line and result register.

anchors.name: write_ok
anchors.why: Write-hit strobe: pokes write data into the bank line.

anchors.name: mem_req
anchors.why: Memory request asserted in push or pull states.

anchors.name: mem_ack
anchors.why: Memory acknowledge; ends push/pull and qualifies refill/write strobes.

anchors.name: mem_rdata
anchors.why: Memory read data used to refill the bank and the result register.

anchors.name: lat_d
anchors.why: Latched write data; feeds bank poke, result register and mem_wdata.

anchors.name: bank_q
anchors.why: Bank read data captured into the result register on read hit.

anchors.name: is_wait
anchors.why: Wait-state decode gating request accept, ready and stall.

anchors.name: cpu_we
anchors.why: Read/write command input latched into lat_w.

anchors.name: stall_o
anchors.why: Busy indication while FSM is outside wait/done.

groups.name: cache_fsm
groups.description: Mode register with one-hot style decodes sequencing lookup, write-through and refill.

groups.name: request_latch
groups.description: Holds address, write flag and write data for the whole transaction.

groups.name: line_bank
groups.description: cc_bank child: tag compare gives hit, refill and poke strobes update lines.

groups.name: cpu_side
groups.description: CPU request/response handshake; out_r result register drives read data.

groups.name: mem_side
groups.description: Memory req/ack bus for write-through and line refill.
